name: Peas Mint Soup
ingredients: 2 cups (300 g) green peas, fresh or frozen
Lemon juice, salt and black pepper
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the stock and peas and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the mint and blend with the silken tofu until very smooth.
Reheat without boiling to keep the colour bright.
Season with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
note: Peas are one of the best everyday plant protein and fibre sources; silken tofu adds creaminess.
